verdict.why: 6 critical failure(s) on the demo path or on high-risk features.

report.summary: ShopLite, our e-commerce online shop selling everyday consumer goods, is not safe to demo. Across 13 pages the QA run logged 416 passed, 6 critical failures, 10 other failures, 4 blocked, 155 not tested, and 0 needing human review. The six critical failures are the resources check on the anonymous homepage, the Help link on the homepage, an old session still valid after logout on the cart page, a privilege escalation via client-side role control on admin, a design check on the logged-in homepage, and an empty cart showing a state message with no totals or checkout controls.
